<!--
  The totals of an order: subtotal, shipping, tax and the total, with a checkout button and a note. Axes: layout
  (card, plain), cta (show, hide), note (show, hide), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SummaryRow, SummaryLabels } from "./order-summary.types";

export type OrderSummaryProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  labels: SummaryLabels;
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  cta?: "show" | "hide";
  note?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, fmtMoney } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  rows,
  labels,
  layout = "card",
  cta = "show",
  note = "show",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<OrderSummaryProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" measure="md">
    <Box
      :class="cn(
        (((layout as string) === 'card') ? 'rounded bg-card p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border' : '')
      )"
      data-testid="summary"
    >
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <ListItem v-for="row in rows" :key="row.id"
            :class="cn(
              'flex items-center justify-between gap-4',
              (
                row.strong ? 'border-t border-border pt-4 text-base font-bold'
                : 'text-sm text-muted-foreground'
              )
            )"
            data-testid="item"
          >
            <Inline>
              {{ row.label }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline>
              {{ fmtMoney(row.amount, row.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Button
          v-if="((cta as string) === 'show')"
          variant="default"
          size="default"
          class="w-full"
          data-testid="checkout"
        >
          {{ labels.checkout }}
        </Button>
        <Text v-if="((note as string) === 'show')" size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ labels.note }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
